title: Double RSI (H1+M1) oversold/overbought + pin bar/doji reversal grid
entry_long: RSI7 on H1 < 30 AND RSI7 on current TF (M1) < 30 (both oversold) THEN wait for bullish pin bar/doji (lower wick > upper wick, lower wick long) on confirmation candle -> buy 0.01
entry_short: mirror: RSI7 H1 and current TF both > 70 (overbought) THEN bearish pin bar/doji (upper wick long) -> sell 0.01
exit: close all (per side) when unrealized profit > $5; no SL, no TP on individual orders
buildon_idea: add explicit Max Order cap and a hard SL/percent cut-loss (narrator himself suggests adding Cut Loss and Max Order in outro); keep the dual-TF RSI+pinbar filter which already reduces overtrading
novelty_note: dual-timeframe RSI confluence + pin/doji confirmation before entry, then directional grid-add on adverse move; filter reduces trade frequency vs typical always-on grid - moderate novelty

title: Range-bound grid trading between user-defined upper/lower horizontal lines, trend-filtered
entry_long: price within [lower,upper] band AND mode_B=true (trend-following toggle, user sets true only in uptrend) AND no nearby buy within Distance -> buy 0.01, TP at Distance pips, no SL
entry_short: mirror: price within band AND mode_S=true (only in downtrend) AND no nearby sell within Distance -> sell 0.01, TP at Distance pips, no SL
exit: individual TP at Distance pips per order; portfolio cut-loss when floating loss exceeds 3% of balance -> close all + terminate
risk_flag_note: 3% balance cut-loss acts as circuit breaker
buildon_idea: already has 3% balance cut-loss and one-sided trend filter; extend to auto-detect trend (e.g. EMA slope) instead of manual mode_B/mode_S toggle, and test across multiple symbols/TFs since author claims universal applicability
novelty_note: simple range grid but distinguishing feature is manual trend-direction gating (buy-only in uptrend) to avoid counter-trend grid legs; low-medium novelty

title: MultiGroup dynamic-grid EA with doubling distance, doubling lot, capped orders + hedge fallback
timeframe: small TF (1-5min mentioned for candle sizing)
entry_long: group1: RSI oversold + reversal candle pattern (ID1 wick>=40% or <=10% variants, body>=100pips) -> buy 0.01, range_of_buy starts at 60 pips and doubles(x2) each subsequent add
entry_short: group2: mirror RSI overbought + reversal pattern -> sell 0.01, range_of_sell doubles each add
exit: per-group close when unrealized profit > $5; global cut-loss at -3000 -> close both groups + terminate
escalation_cap: 5.0 lots (volume_upper_limit) + Max Order 6 per group then switches to hedge-mode group
buildon_idea: already capped (5 lots, max 6 orders/group, -3000 cut-loss, hedge fallback beyond 6); flat-lot test first to isolate entry edge, then try linear/log lot law instead of x2 doubling to reduce escalation risk
novelty_note: adds dynamic (doubling) grid distance on top of doubling lot, plus a two-group hedge system once max orders exceeded - more engineered than typical basic grid EAs seen in this corpus

title: Semi-auto modify-TP averaging EA (manual first entry + auto breakeven TP management)
indicators: external indicator (user-supplied, e.g. Bollinger Bands) for manual first entry
entry_long: manual click 'Open Buy' button (or external indicator signal) opens first buy at Lot_BS; on adverse move every 100 pips, auto-adds buy at same growing lot, stepping lot +0.01 every 5 orders
entry_short: mirror manual 'Open Sell' button; auto-adds sell every 100 pips on adverse move, lot +0.01 every 5 orders
exit: TP dynamically recalculated as breakeven price +/- 65 pips (modify-TP), moved after every add; cut-loss at -$10 closes all and stops (must manually reopen)
buildon_idea: already capped at 1 lot with tight -$10 cut-loss; buildable extension: swap manual first-entry trigger for the same dual-RSI+pinbar filter from EX202/204 to reduce reliance on operator judgment, keep modify-TP breakeven logic which is a reusable exit-management module
novelty_note: semi-auto design (external indicator drives entry, EA drives money management) + modify-TP-to-breakeven mechanism is a distinct reusable exit pattern vs standard fixed-TP grids

title: Semi-auto dynamic-grid martingale with doubling distance and doubling lot, single-set close
indicators: external indicator (user-supplied, e.g. Bollinger Bands) for manual first entry
entry_long: manual/EA button click opens first buy at Lot_BS (default 0.01); on adverse move, distance doubles each add (range_of_buy x2, adjust_distance=2) and lot doubles each add (BS x2)
exit: close all when profit > $5 (single set, resets after); cut-loss configurable (-50 demoed, adjustable via EA properties e.g. -1000)
buildon_idea: add explicit Max Order / lot cap (narrator adjusts cut-loss money only, not lot ceiling); flat-lot test to check if manual entry signal has edge before layering x2/x2 escalation; try 1.5x instead of 2x for both distance and lot to soften tail risk
novelty_note: couples distance-doubling with lot-doubling simultaneously (steeper escalation than EX204/205); adjustable via single 'adjust_distance' percent parameter - moderate novelty in parameterization

title: Breakout Master-Bar + RSI filter triggering multi-level pending order grid (buy/sell stop ladder)
entry_long: detect large bearish candle (body>100pips) -> draw horizontal Line_Buy at its high; when price crosses above Line_Buy AND RSI(current TF)<30 (oversold) -> place 5 buy-stop pending orders spaced 100 pips apart, volume growing 200%(doubling) each level, no SL/TP
entry_short: mirror: large bullish candle -> Line_Sell at its low; cross below AND RSI>70 -> 5 sell-stop pending orders, 100 pips spacing, doubling volume
exit: close all + delete remaining pendings when unrealized profit > $10; cut-loss at -$10 closes all + delete pendings
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed 5-order pending ladder, self-limiting by order count)
buildon_idea: ladder is naturally capped at 5 orders; extension: use maker-side pending orders (already does) but add per-order SL/TP instead of only portfolio-level $10 cut/take, and test RSI thresholds at true 30/70 (author admits he swapped them for demo speed)
novelty_note: master-bar breakout level + pending-order-grid-in (single-block multi-level ladder) is a distinct entry mechanism from earlier market-order grids in this corpus

title: Semi-auto manual-entry EA triggering 15-level buy-stop/sell-stop pending order ladder
indicators: external indicator (user-supplied) for manual first-entry decision
entry_long: manual button click 'Open Buy' (one-time, single first entry) -> EA auto-places 15 buy-stop pending orders spaced Grid_Distance (200 pips default, 3000 demoed on BTC) apart, volume growing by next_volume_size% (200% = doubling) per level, no SL/TP
entry_short: mirror manual 'Open Sell' -> 15 sell-stop pending ladder
exit: close all + delete remaining pendings when profit > $50; cut-loss at -$50 closes all + delete pendings
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed 15-order pending ladder + 1.0 lot cap on first entry)
buildon_idea: naturally capped by fixed 15-order ladder; extension is same as EX207 - pair with an automated entry filter (RSI/MACD/breakout) instead of pure manual click, and lower the 200% doubling to a flatter growth (e.g. 150%) to soften worst-case exposure across 15 levels
novelty_note: near-identical mechanism to EX207 but manual-trigger (semi-auto) and larger 15-order ladder; low incremental novelty vs EX207

title: MACD histogram alignment (H1) trend filter gating M1 directional scalp-grid
entry_long: H1 MACD > 0 AND histogram bars ID1>ID2>ID3>ID4 (strictly increasing magnitude, uptrend alignment) -> set mode_buy=1, then on M1 open buy-only every 150 pips distance; first 5 orders fixed lot 0.01, from order 6 onward lot +0.01 per order
entry_short: mirror: H1 MACD<0 and histogram increasingly negative (ID1 most negative) -> mode_sell=1, sell-only grid every 150 pips, same lot-step rule
exit: close all when total floating profit > 100 pips; cut-loss at -$3000 closes all and resets
escalation_cap: none stated (lot grows +0.01 indefinitely past 5th order, bounded only by -$3000 cut-loss)
buildon_idea: add explicit max-order/lot cap (currently only monetary -3000 backstop); the MACD histogram-alignment trend filter (4 consecutive increasing/decreasing bars) is a reusable, distinctive signal worth cataloging even if grid sizing needs tightening
novelty_note: MACD histogram 4-bar monotonic alignment as regime filter (not just zero-cross) is a more specific/novel signal than plain MACD cross seen elsewhere in corpus

title: Semi-auto directional grid with 4 fixed-lot orders then stepped lot increase
indicators: external indicator (user-supplied) recommended for manual first entry
entry_long: manual/EA button opens first buy; subsequent buy-adds every 150 pips distance; orders 1-4 fixed at Lot_Start(0.01), from order 5 onward lot increases +0.01 per order (Lot_BS)
exit: close all when floating profit > 100 pips (pip-based); cut-loss at -$3000 closes all and resets (adjustable, e.g. down to -$1 or -$50)
escalation_cap: none stated on lot growth (monetary -3000 backstop only)
buildon_idea: same pattern as EX209 - add hard max-order/lot cap; concept of '4 fixed orders then escalate' is a gentler ramp than immediate doubling and could pair well with a validated entry filter for build-on testing
novelty_note: delayed escalation (first 4 orders flat, then linear ramp) is a softer variant vs immediate martingale-doubling designs elsewhere in corpus

title: Support/resistance wick-rejection reversal with Custom Sequence (1-2-3-5x) bet sizing
entry_long: price breaks below 14-period low (support) then later a candle's low pierces the support line but closes back above it (wick rejection) -> buy at Custom Sequence lot (base 0.01, escalates 1x/2x/3x/5x on consecutive losses, resets to 1x on win), SL 30 pips, TP 50 pips
entry_short: mirror: price breaks above 14-period high (resistance) then wick rejection candle closes back below -> sell with same Custom Sequence sizing, SL30/TP50
exit: per-trade SL 30 pips or TP 50 pips (fixed R:R ~1:1.67); on loss, next trade uses next sequence multiple; on win, resets to base volume
lot_law_note: FXDreema 'Custom Sequence' betting scheme, closest analogue is a bounded loss-streak multiplier (1,2,3,5x), not classic doubling martingale
escalation_cap: 5x base volume (sequence caps at 5x per stated steps, resets on win)
buildon_idea: already has per-trade SL/TP and a bounded 1-2-3-5x sequence (not naive martingale); build-on: extend candle_period/SL/TP sweep across more symbols/TFs since author only spot-checked EURUSD month-by-month; verify sequence multiplier resets are followed by a hard max-consecutive-loss circuit breaker
novelty_note: wick-rejection-through-S/R with a Labouchere/Fibonacci-like bounded position-sizing sequence (rather than doubling martingale) is a distinct and relatively novel risk-sizing approach in this corpus

title: Martingale x2 grid with EMA(3/8) reversal-confirmed adds and profit-scaled trailing stop
entry_long: manual/EA button opens first buy; on adverse move (price below prior buy open, distance >=20 pips) AND EMA3 crosses above EMA8 (reversal confirmation) -> add buy at lot x2 (martingale)
entry_short: mirror: adverse move up >=20 pips AND EMA3 crosses below EMA8 -> add sell at lot x2
exit: trailing-stop ('Tailing Stop') activates only once Equity>Balance, with activation profit threshold scaling by order count (e.g. 1 order: profit>$60, 2 orders: >$120, N orders: >$60*N); cut-loss at -$3000 closes all and resets
escalation_cap: none stated (lot doubles 0.01->0.02->0.04...indefinitely, bounded only by -$3000 cut-loss)
buildon_idea: add explicit max-order/lot cap on the x2 escalation (only -3000 money backstop exists); the order-count-scaled trailing-stop activation threshold ($60 x N orders) is a reusable, distinctive exit-management module worth extracting even if the martingale sizing needs tightening to linear/log
novelty_note: gating each martingale add behind an EMA reversal-cross signal (not blind distance-triggered adds) plus a trailing-stop whose activation profit scales with open-order count is more engineered than typical corpus martingale EAs
